title: You were promoted
caption: AI moves you from doing the work to stewarding it. The way across is management skills you already use with people.

gap.label: the misalignment
gap.many: Many still act as if they do the work

many-skip-the-management-steps.description: In 9,830 Claude.ai conversations, 51.1 percent stated a goal, 15.8 percent questioned the reasoning and 8.7 percent checked facts; no study measures executing versus managing, so the research supports “many”, not “most” [1].

workers-describe-the-shift.description: In a survey of 319 weekly GenAI users, effort moved from executing tasks to stewarding them and from gathering information to verifying it, while higher confidence in the AI went with less checking [1].

lee-critical-thinking.title: Lee et al., The Impact of Generative AI on Critical Thinking: Self-Reported Reductions in Cognitive Effort and Confidence Effects From a Survey of Knowledge Workers (CHI 2025)

stepping-stone-break-it-down.description: Users split complex tasks into smaller steps, which creates a feedback loop where the model corrects course [1].

anthropic-economic-index-primitives.title: Anthropic, Economic Index: New building blocks for AI use (January 2026)

communication-barrier.description: He says there is a communication barrier between a person and an AI agent, located in vocabulary: they do not share the same language, so you need a shared language; the phrase “language barrier” is not his, and the management reading is this project's inference [1].

pocock-software-fundamentals.title: Matt Pocock, Software Fundamentals Matter More Than Ever (AI Engineer Europe 2026)

you-were-promoted.title: You were promoted
you-were-promoted.script: So here is the way to read it. AI promotes you. You move from doing the work to managing the work, and the work doesn't shrink, it changes, so that you can do things that were out of reach before.

the-misalignment.title: The misalignment
the-misalignment.script: That move has a gap, and it is the biggest misalignment people face today. Many of us still sit in the execution box, acting as if we do the work ourselves, when the new job is to manage it.

four-stepping-stones.title: Four stepping stones
four-stepping-stones.script: The way across is four stepping stones: break it down, write clear goals, review, and delegate. Notice that none of these is a technical skill, you already know them from working with people, and each one makes you more confident with what comes back.

the-barrier.title: The barrier
the-barrier.script: And there is a reason the gap is real. Picture asking the AI for "the usual report" and getting back something polished that answers a question you never asked. Nothing broke, it just had none of the words in your head. So before your next handoff, spend one minute writing down the terms you take for granted, and use them every time.
